'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea DS Come Here You Big Coward''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''Star Wars Has Cards?'''. Handwritten. Line 31 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V); line 52 Executor: Gun Station → Executor: Gunnery Station. Shield 11 '''Well Let Fate-a Decide, Huh? (V)''' as written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Come Here You Big Coward]]
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
